description: The Ryu Warmup app: schedules a one-word ping to each subscription agent, on its cheapest model, at chosen local times — so a rolling usage window is already open when work starts. Shipped as a full-page Companion (Path B, ui_format:"html"). Drives Core's /api/agents, /api/agents/:id/usage, /api/agents/:id/acp-config and /heartbeat/jobs through the warmup:crud bridge capability; built to one self-contained HTML via vite-plugin-singlefile. Consumes @ryu/ui components (tree-shaken into the single-file bundle).
name: @ryu/warmup-app
